Leave empty to discover the Mac automatically
Must match the port set on the Mac
Android only lets an app touch the clipboard while it has a window on screen. MacDroidSync opens an invisible window for a fraction of a second, which requires this permission.
Enter the pairing code shown in the Mac menu
Silent placeholder shown while no Mac is connected. It has no status bar icon.
Shown while a Mac is connected, with the action that sends this phone\'s clipboard.
Clipboard items waiting to be applied.
Rings this phone when you ping it from the Mac, so you can find it.
Ringing this phone. Tap Silence to stop.
Tap to put it on this phone\'s clipboard.
Progress of the files being sent to the Mac.
The Mac never confirmed the transfer
No Mac connected, nothing to lock
Lock the Mac when I walk away

While the clipboard sync is on, the phone broadcasts a short Bluetooth signal every quarter of a second. The Mac averages its strength and locks its screen once the average says you have left, which also means the Mac needs this switched on in its own menu. Nothing is scanned and nothing is connected to; the signal carries no data beyond a token derived from the pairing code.
Turn the clipboard sync on: the beacon only broadcasts while it is running.
Grant Nearby devices in Settings, otherwise the phone cannot broadcast. Tap here to open it.
Folders on this phone are kept the same as folders on the Mac. The pairs are set up on the Mac, in Settings › Folders.
Allow access to all files, otherwise the synced folders cannot be read. Tap here to open it.

Lets the Mac show the conversations on this phone and send replies typed there. Messages are read on request and sent only when you press Send on the Mac. Contacts are optional; without them the Mac shows numbers.

The Mac decides what to look for and how often to ask; this phone answers and sends what is asked for. Photos travel as they are, so the location and the rest of the EXIF survive the trip. The only thing set up here is the permission to read the camera folder, because that is the one thing a Mac cannot grant.
Photo sync is set up on the Mac.
Grant Photos and videos in Settings, otherwise the camera folder cannot be read. Tap here to open it.

Without this, Android removes the GPS tags from every photo it hands over, and the copy on the Mac would silently lose where it was taken. MacDroidSync refuses to send photos rather than deliver them stripped.
Share any file with MacDroidSync to drop it in the Mac\'s Downloads folder.
%1$s is on its way to the Mac
%1$d files are on their way to the Mac
Text sent to the Mac\'s clipboard
Notify while the camera is on

A camera that is switched on announces itself over Bluetooth, which this phone notices in the background, with or without FUJIFILM XApp. A notification shows while the camera is on and goes away when it is switched off. Tapping it opens a remote shutter.
No paired devices. Pair the camera with this phone in FUJIFILM XApp first.
Lets MacDroidSync list the devices paired with this phone and notice the camera when it is switched on, then connect to it. It is never used for location.
Send location and time to the camera

While the camera is on, this phone connects to it and sends the time and its location at this interval, so photos carry where and when they were taken. With the camera off nothing is sent and the location is not read.
Android lets the link to the camera start in the background only for a device you confirmed as this app\'s companion.
The camera was not found. Switch it on and try again.
Only while in use, choose "Allow all the time"
The camera is mostly on with this phone in a pocket, so the location has to be readable with no screen of MacDroidSync open.
Tap for one photo. Hold for as long as the camera\'s own button would be held: continuous shooting or bulb.
Time sent at %1$s, no accurate location
The camera is switched on and in Bluetooth range
Shown while the Fujifilm camera is switched on
Saved. Turn the clipboard sync on to connect.
Clipboard, files and presence between this phone and your Mac, over your own Wi-Fi.
MacDroidSync costs nothing, carries no advertising and sends nothing anywhere except to the Mac you paired it with.
The wire format, the key derivation and the cross platform test vectors are documented in PROTOCOL.md in the source repository.
